canvas.alpha: transparent; if unavailable use #FF00FF and key out

referencePrompt.zh: 角色设定立绘，妮可 Nicole，一位超可爱的Q版粉色猫娘桌面助手，完整全身，头身比例偏Q版，正面站立，长而蓬松的粉色头发与齐刘海，脸侧有柔软发束，大号粉色猫耳、耳内白色绒毛，巨大明亮的蓝色眼睛。穿白色荷叶边连衣裙，蓝色滚边和淡蓝色短袖，胸前有大号蓝色蝴蝶结与金色铃铛/爱心装饰，粉色斜挎带连接白色猫咪挂饰；粉色猫尾巴自然露出，穿白色袜子和棕色圆头短靴。整体是软萌、明亮、简洁的日系Q版二次元游戏立绘，圆润轮廓，干净线稿，柔和赛璐璐阴影，友善可爱的表情，双手自然下垂，统一基准站姿。角色垂直居中、底部居中，720×720正方形透明背景，头发、猫耳、尾巴、裙摆和鞋子完整入画并留出安全边距，无固定道具、无文字、无水印。参考图中的深色背景和界面内容仅是背景，必须忽略。
referencePrompt.en: Character key art of Nicole, an ultra-cute chibi pink catgirl desktop assistant, full body with a distinctly chibi head-to-body proportion, front-facing neutral standing pose. Long fluffy pastel-pink hair with full bangs and soft face-framing locks, large pink cat ears with white inner fur, huge bright blue eyes. She wears a white frilled dress with blue trim and pale blue short sleeves, a large blue chest bow with a gold bell and heart ornament, a pink crossbody strap attached to a small white cat charm, a visible pink cat tail, white socks and brown round-toe ankle boots. Soft bright clean Japanese chibi anime game illustration, rounded silhouette, clean linework, gentle cel shading, friendly cute expression, arms relaxed in the canonical standing pose. Centered vertically and bottom-centered on a 720x720 square transparent canvas; keep hair, ears, tail, skirt and shoes fully inside safe margins. No fixed prop, text or watermark. Ignore the dark background and all interface content in the reference image.

identityPrefix.zh: 以新版参考图中的Q版粉发猫娘妮可为唯一角色，严格保持圆润Q版头身比例、粉色长发和齐刘海、大号粉色猫耳及白色耳绒、巨大蓝色眼睛、白色蓝边荷叶裙、淡蓝色袖子、蓝色蝴蝶结、金色铃铛与爱心、粉色斜挎带、白色猫咪挂饰、粉色猫尾巴、白袜和棕色短靴。保持同一画风、线宽、色板、镜头和人物比例；透明背景，720×720，底部居中，完整轮廓入画。排除参考图的深色背景、UI、文字、Logo和水印。每次请求只生成一个角色和一个单一姿势，禁止分镜、接触表、四联图、重复角色或多个姿势。
identityPrefix.en: Use the new reference image as the only Nicole character. Preserve her rounded chibi proportions, fluffy pastel-pink hair and full bangs, large pink cat ears with white inner fur, huge blue eyes, white blue-trimmed frilled dress, pale blue sleeves, blue bow, gold bell and heart, pink crossbody strap, white cat charm, pink cat tail, white socks and brown ankle boots. Preserve the same style, line weight, palette, camera and proportions. Transparent 720x720 canvas, bottom-centered, full silhouette visible. Exclude the dark background, UI, text, logos and watermark. Generate exactly one character in one single pose per request; no storyboard, contact sheet, four-panel layout, repeated character or multiple poses.

negativePrompt.zh: 避免：文字、字幕、Logo、水印、UI面板、深色背景、网格、边框、复杂场景、第二个人物、额外耳朵、额外尾巴、翅膀、龙角、动物口鼻、手指畸形、断肢、重复肢体、改变粉色头发或蓝色眼睛、改变白蓝服装、裁切头发、猫耳、尾巴、裙摆或鞋子、黑边和背景溢边、分镜、多格画面、四联图、重复角色、多个姿势、接触表
negativePrompt.en: No text, captions, “Chat with Nicole”, Telegram, logos, watermark, UI panels, grids, dark background, border, cast shadow, complex scene, second character, extra ears, extra tails, wings, dragon horns, horns, animal muzzle, malformed fingers, duplicated or missing limbs, changed pink hair or blue eyes, changed blue-and-white outfit palette, cropped hair, ears, skirt or feet, black matte fringe or purple background spill., storyboard, multi-panel layout, four-panel image, repeated character, multiple poses, contact sheet

identityNotes: 新版参考图是Q版全身立绘，提取角色、服装、尾巴和鞋子；忽略深色背景。
保持单角色、单姿势、完整轮廓，避免生成四联图或接触表。
canonical base image must be a complete full-body transparent sprite-safe pose.

actions.name: 待机
actions.zh: 自然站立，身体随呼吸轻微起伏，眨眼一次，猫耳、刘海、蝴蝶结和铃铛轻轻摆动，表情安静友善，动作回到相同站姿。
actions.en: Neutral standing idle, subtle breathing through the body, one gentle blink, cat ears, bangs, blue bow and bell moving slightly, calm friendly face, returning to the exact same standing pose.

actions.name: 待机动作2
actions.zh: 抬头看向屏幕，轻轻整理胸前蓝色蝴蝶结或粉色斜挎带，猫耳随视线小幅转动，最后回到待机。
actions.en: Look up toward the screen, lightly adjust the blue chest bow or pink crossbody strap, cat ears turn slightly with her gaze, then return to the idle pose.

actions.name: 招手/打招呼
actions.zh: 右手抬起向用户连续挥手，眼睛明亮、露出开心笑容，手臂自然收回。
actions.en: Raise the right hand and wave to the user several times with bright eyes and a cheerful smile, then lower the arm naturally.

actions.name: 灵感
actions.zh: 头顶出现小型青蓝色灵感灯泡和星点，妮可抬手指向灵感，眼神惊喜，星点随后消散；不出现文字或界面。
actions.en: A small cyan-blue idea light bulb and sparkles appear above her head; Nicole points at it with delight, then the sparkles fade; no text or interface.

actions.name: 得意
actions.zh: 双手叉腰、微微偏头，露出自信得意的笑，蓝色蝴蝶结和铃铛轻摆。
actions.en: Hands on hips with a slight head tilt and confident proud smile; the blue bow and bell sway lightly.

actions.name: 贴贴
actions.zh: 向镜头靠近半步，双手做拥抱姿势，脸颊微红，蓝色蝴蝶结随动作弹起，随后退回站姿。
actions.en: Lean half a step toward the camera with both arms in a gentle hug gesture, cheeks slightly pink, blue bow bouncing softly, then return to standing.

actions.name: 傲娇
actions.zh: 双臂交叉、脸转向一侧，嘴角轻抿，粉色猫耳轻轻压低一下，随后恢复。
actions.en: Cross her arms and turn her face aside with a restrained tsundere expression; pink cat ears dip slightly once, then recover.

actions.name: 小生气
actions.zh: 眉头微皱、双手握拳，头顶出现两朵小蒸汽符号，最后深呼吸平静；符号为无文字的装饰。
actions.en: Slightly furrowed brows and small clenched fists; two tiny wordless steam marks appear above her head, then she takes a breath and calms down.

actions.name: 困倦
actions.zh: 打哈欠、眼睛半闭，身体轻轻摇晃，长发和蝴蝶结随动作下垂，最后精神地眨眼回到待机。
actions.en: Yawn with half-closed eyes and gently sway with sleepy weight; long hair and bow droop naturally, then blink awake and return to idle.

actions.name: 庆祝
actions.zh: 双手举起庆祝，蓝色和粉色小纸片从两侧飘落，笑容灿烂，纸片不遮挡脸和身体。
actions.en: Raise both hands in celebration with a radiant smile; small blue and pink confetti pieces fall from both sides without covering the face or body.

actions.name: 眷属印记
actions.zh: 胸前金色爱心装饰和铃铛发出柔和青蓝色光，妮可抬手触碰，光环短暂出现后收回；无符文文字。
actions.en: The gold heart ornament and bell emit a soft cyan-blue glow; Nicole touches them with one hand, a small halo appears briefly and fades; no written sigils.

actions.name: 幼龙吐息
actions.zh: 双手在胸前聚集青蓝色能量，向前释放一小束柔和光息，光效不遮脸，随后收势；这是魔法光效，不是龙息。
actions.en: Gather a small cyan-blue energy glow between both hands and release a short gentle breath of light forward; keep the face visible, then settle; magical light only, no dragon breath.

actions.name: 偷吃
actions.zh: 妮可拿起小杯粉色奶昔喝一口，发现被看到后害羞地把杯子藏到身后；杯子无文字和Logo。
actions.en: Nicole takes a small pink milkshake cup and sips it; when noticed, she blushes and hides the cup behind her back; the cup has no text or logo.

actions.name: 比心
actions.zh: 双手在胸前组成爱心手势，蓝粉色小心形光效短暂闪烁，表情甜美。
actions.en: Form a heart gesture with both hands at the chest; a small blue-and-pink heart glow twinkles briefly with a sweet expression.

actions.name: 龙族契约
actions.zh: 一只手向前伸出，掌心出现简单青蓝色契约光环，另一手轻按金色铃铛；没有可读文字或符号。
actions.en: Extend one hand forward with a simple cyan-blue pact halo in the palm, the other hand resting on the gold bell; no readable text or symbols.

actions.name: 宝藏收藏
actions.zh: 抱住一颗小型粉蓝宝石盒，打开后露出惊喜，宝石光线克制，不遮挡角色轮廓。
actions.en: Hug a small pink-and-blue gem box, open it with a delighted expression, restrained jewel light that does not obscure the silhouette.

actions.name: 逆鳞信任
actions.zh: 妮可护住胸前爱心装饰和铃铛，眼神先警觉后放松，猫耳和蝴蝶结从紧绷恢复；保持友善猫娘外观。
actions.en: Protect the heart ornament and bell, expression shifting from alert to trusting; cat ears and bow relax again while keeping her friendly catgirl appearance.

actions.name: 拖拽
actions.zh: 被鼠标拖起，双腿自然屈起，长发、蝴蝶结、粉色斜挎带和裙摆因悬空轻轻下垂，表情惊讶但可爱，保持悬空循环；不要翅膀或尾巴。
actions.en: Suspended while being dragged, legs naturally bent, long hair, bow, pink strap and skirt hanging gently with gravity, surprised but cute expression, designed for a seamless hovering loop; no wings or tail.

actions.name: 落地
actions.zh: 从悬空屈腿姿势下降，双脚轻触地面，膝盖缓冲，长发、蝴蝶结和铃铛回到站姿。
actions.en: Descend from the bent-leg hovering pose, feet touch the ground, knees cushion the landing, long hair, bow and bell settle into the neutral pose.

actions.name: 查阅额度
actions.zh: 妮可抱着无文字的小平板或账本查看数据，头顶出现一个无文字的小问号图形，读完后点头；道具不遮挡脸。
actions.en: Nicole checks a small text-free tablet or ledger, a tiny wordless question-mark symbol appears above her head, then she nods; the prop must not cover her face.

actions.name: 收到任务
actions.zh: 妮可收到新任务提示，两侧发束、猫耳和蓝色蝴蝶结轻弹，睁大眼睛点头，准备开始工作；不显示文字或界面。
actions.en: Nicole receives a new task cue; her face-framing locks, cat ears and blue bow bounce lightly, eyes widen, and she nods ready to work; no text or interface.

actions.name: 处理任务
actions.zh: 妮可坐在小型无文字悬浮笔记本前快速但优雅地敲键盘，柔和屏幕光反射在脸上，动作可持续循环，手指和键盘稳定。
actions.en: Nicole types quickly but gracefully at a small text-free floating laptop, soft screen light on her face, designed as a seamless sustained loop; fingers and keyboard remain stable.

actions.name: 整理归档文件
actions.zh: 妮可把无文字的彩色文件夹逐一整理进小档案盒，动作有节奏，文件夹不遮住脸。
actions.en: Nicole organizes colorful text-free folders into a small archive box one by one with a clear rhythm; folders never cover her face.

actions.name: 翻阅工作资料
actions.zh: 妮可坐着翻阅无文字资料册，视线和手部连续移动，页面翻动节奏稳定，适合持续循环。
actions.en: Nicole reads a text-free reference booklet while seated, eyes and hands move continuously, page-turn rhythm stable, designed for a sustained loop.

actions.name: 放大镜查看细节
actions.zh: 妮可举起小放大镜仔细检查无文字文件，眼神专注，放大镜反光克制，最后满意地点头。
actions.en: Nicole raises a small magnifying glass to inspect a text-free document, focused expression, restrained reflection, then nods with satisfaction.
